scenicChapters.title: Natchez Trace Parkway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 23 km this is Natchez Trace Parkway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Remains of Villages on Nozaki Island → Kasuga Village and Sacred Place
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 46 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-egami-village-on-naru-island-vill.story: A 275 km round trip from Fukuechō - roughly 5 h in the saddle. It goes by way of Villages on Kashiragashima Island, Kasuga Village and Sacred Places in Hirado, back through Kasuga Village and Sacred Places in Hirado and Egami Village on Naru Island. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
